## Objective

What protocol or architecture outcome is needed?

## Scope

Describe the expected work and affected contracts or services.

## Design documentation

Link the design document or outline the design that must be documented before implementation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The design and trade-offs are documented.
- [ ] Contract interfaces and migration implications are addressed, when applicable.
- [ ] Tests and generated contract specs are updated, when applicable.

## Security impact

Describe effects on authorization, fund custody, invariants, and failure handling. Include risks and mitigations, or explain why there is no security impact.

## Dependencies and open questions

List related issues, decisions, or unresolved questions.
